title: sphaeralcea angustifolia subsp. cuspidata
intro: Sphaeralcea angustifolia subsp. cuspidata, commonly known as Narrowleaf Gumplant or Cuspidate Globe Mallow, is a perennial plant species within the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a possible treatment for conditions such as wounds, burns, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
